name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne Stages 1-2

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '75 Sharps Road, Tullamarine VIC 3043' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100); PeeringDB facility point (-37.70803, 144.87569) is ~90m away.

builder.note: FDC project page (source 4): base building, Data Hall 1; stage not stated but Kapitol's portfolio starts at Stage 2, so FDC is taken as the Stage 1 builder. Kapitol (source 6): Stage 2 base build + fit-out, 7-month programme, delivered Jan 2019. Later stages by Kapitol: see nextdc-m2-stage4, -stage5, -stage6, -stage9-11

mw_it.note: Stages 1 and 2 merged into one row (decision 2026-09-27) because Stage 1 alone (~4 MW, derived) is below the 5 MW floor. NEXTDC FY20 deck: M2 'Installed capacity 10MW' at 30 Jun 2020 (source 11) = Stage 1 + Stage 2 (Stage 2 'added an additional 6MW', source 6). Earlier figures are whole-site targets: 2MW initial / 25MW planned (May 2016, source 1); 40MW target (FY17 AR, source 3). Later stages are separate rows: nextdc-m2-stage4 (18MW), -stage5 (15MW), -stage6 (8MW), -stage9-11 (60MW, under construction); campus now marketed as 120MW+ (source 7)

cost_aud_m.note: '$85 million' covering land, base building and infrastructure (May 2016 announcement as reported by iTnews and The Urban Developer). FY17 AR: B2 and M2 together 'an investment of over $100 million so far' (source 3)

authority.note: 75 Sharps Rd is in the City of Brimbank (Brimbank planning register; PlanningAlerts P341/2022 at 75 Sharps Rd, source 14), not Hume as earlier assumed

pathway.value: council planning permit (Planning and Environment Act 1987)

reference.note: the Brimbank register lists P589/2016 as the data centre permit for 75 Sharps Rd (amendments Pt 5-7, 2023-2025). The register starts Dec 2018, so the original 2016 grant is not listed; taking P589/2016 as the Stage 1 permit rests on its 2016 number and the site (inference)

lodged.note: 2016 per permit number; exact date not found

jobs_construction_other.note: The Urban Developer (23 May 2016): construction 'expected to support up to 200 jobs on and off-site' (iTnews: 'up to 200' direct jobs)
'up to 200 jobs on and off-site, with another 100 jobs supported deeper in the supply chain' = 300 total

construction_start.note: site acquired May 2016 (source 8); FY17 AR says development began during FY17 (Jul 2016-Jun 2017); exact start not found; Stage 2: 7-month programme ending Jan 2019 implies roughly mid-2018 (inference)

construction_end.note: Stage 2 'delivered one month ahead of programme in January 2019' (Kapitol). Stage 1 opened November 2017 as 'Victoria's first UTI Tier IV certified data centre' (NEXTDC history, source 8)

open_questions: planning permit P589/2016: original grant date not found (Brimbank register starts Dec 2018)
FDC stage not explicitly stated on its page
